#  44405 - Process System Engineering Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **44405 - module is no longer offered from WS 2012/13**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Process System Engineering**  |  
|  Prozesssystemtechnik   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 4 - Environmental Sciences and Process Engineering   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Dr. Ing. Heidebrecht, Peter 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every summer semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Introduction in advanced process system analysis and design; Computer-aided modelling, simulation and optimization of process systems.  |  
| Contents:  | Basic principles and methods for analysis and design of chemical processes, estimation of the optimal design conditions, flow sheet simulation and optimization with ChemCAD, case studies, computer applications, examples for gas separation plants, air liquification and separation plants, refinery plants, energy recovery and saving problems in process systems, heatpump application a.s.o.  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Bachelor degree in chemical engineering  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 4 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 120 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Coulson & Richardson\\\\\'s Chemical Engineering, Vol.6, Second edition:R. K. Sinnott: Chemical Engineering Design, 1996,Butterworth-Heinemann, Oxford, ISBN 0 75062557 0  |  
| Module Examination:  | Unspecified - Specification from winter semester 2016/17 required!  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | Participation at exercises and practical simulation training, exercises and practical training reports, written examination 120 min.  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | None  |  
| Module Components:  | 440206 VL Process Engineering  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
